name: American University of Malta
summary: Private American-style university in Bormla (Cospicua), licensed in Malta; ten four-year bachelor's in business, engineering, computing and design.

ib.text: IB Diploma with a minimum of 24 points, finished within five years of the start; an admission interview and proof of English (IELTS, TOEFL or PTE) apply. Some degrees add their own requirements.

noDeadline: Rolling applications; no closing date published

programmes.name: Accounting
programmes.about: Four-year degree (240 ECTS) in financial and managerial accounting, auditing, taxation and accounting information systems; a base for CPA, ACCA or CMA qualifications.
programmes.selectionNote: IB Diploma of at least 24 points, plus an admission interview on background, suitability and English. Places are offered on a rolling basis.

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.about: Four-year degree (240 ECTS) on the functional areas of business: economics, accounting, finance, management, operations, marketing and business ethics, after a broad general education.
programmes.selectionNote: IB Diploma of at least 24 points, plus an admission interview on background, suitability and English. Places are offered on a rolling basis.

programmes.name: Business and Finance
programmes.about: Four-year degree (240 ECTS) combining accounting, economics, marketing and management with a focus on financial theory and practice, for business, banking, investment or consulting.
programmes.selectionNote: IB Diploma of at least 24 points, plus an admission interview on background, suitability and English. Places are offered on a rolling basis.

programmes.name: Civil Engineering
programmes.about: Four-year degree (268 ECTS) in designing, maintaining and operating infrastructure: transport, water supply, wastewater, flood control and buildings, with sustainability and resilience.
programmes.selectionNote: IB Diploma of at least 24 points, plus an admission interview on background, suitability and English. Places are offered on a rolling basis.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.about: Four-year degree (272 ECTS) applying solid mechanics, fluid dynamics, thermodynamics and energy systems to design, analysis and manufacturing across aerospace, automotive and biomedical fields.
programmes.selectionNote: IB Diploma of at least 24 points, plus an admission interview on background, suitability and English. Places are offered on a rolling basis.

programmes.name: Electronics and Communication Engineering
programmes.about: Four-year degree (256 ECTS) in electronics, telecommunications, digital systems and signal processing, with hands-on work on 5G, IoT and embedded systems.
programmes.selectionNote: IB Diploma of at least 24 points, plus an admission interview on background, suitability and English. Places are offered on a rolling basis.

programmes.name: Industrial Engineering
programmes.about: Four-year degree (266 ECTS) on improving systems: process design, optimisation, modelling and simulation, production planning, engineering management and supply chains.
programmes.selectionNote: IB Diploma of at least 24 points, plus an admission interview on background, suitability and English. Places are offered on a rolling basis.

programmes.name: Software Engineering
programmes.about: Programming, software design and computing principles, then industry methods and tools for large-scale systems, with data processing and AI. Four years full-time (240 ECTS); a six-year part-time route exists.
programmes.selectionNote: IB Diploma of at least 24 points, plus an admission interview on background, suitability and English. Places are offered on a rolling basis.

programmes.name: Game Development
programmes.about: Four-year full-time degree (240 ECTS) in game programming, covering computer science and computer graphics for the games industry.
programmes.selectionNote: IB Diploma of at least 24 points, plus an admission interview on background, suitability and English. Places are offered on a rolling basis.

programmes.name: Graphic Design and Animation
programmes.about: Professionally oriented four-year degree (237 ECTS): visual art and design foundations, graphic design and visual communication, and 2D and 3D animation.
programmes.selectionNote: IB Diploma of at least 24 points, plus an admission interview on background, suitability and English. Places are offered on a rolling basis.

notes: AUM is private and fee-paying for everyone; the fee page shows two rates, Arts and Sciences at €8,000 and Engineering at €9,000 a year, each plus €100 registration per semester.
Each programme page says it is accredited by the MFHEA (Malta Further and Higher Education Authority); none names a partner university as the awarding body.
Engineering degrees count more ECTS (256 to 272) than the 240 of the business and computing degrees, so check the course structure before comparing years.
